props.name: point
props.label: point
props.description:
Hovered point payload (denormalised). When `null`, the
tooltip is hidden entirely.

props.name: series
props.label: series
props.description:
Hovered series reference. Companion to `point`. Hidden when
`null` even if `point` is set.

props.name: category
props.label: category
props.description:
Friendly category for the X axis — string when the X axis
is categorical, number otherwise.

props.name: x
props.label: x
props.description: Mouse X position relative to the chart body, in pixels.

props.name: y
props.label: y
props.description: Mouse Y position relative to the chart body, in pixels.

props.name: xAxisFormat
props.label: xAxisFormat
props.description:
Formatter applied to the X value shown in the tooltip body.
Defaults to `String(value)`.

props.name: yAxisFormat
props.label: yAxisFormat
props.description:
Formatter applied to the Y value shown in the tooltip body.
Defaults to `String(value)`.

slots.name: default
slots.label: default
slots.slotPropsType: { point: IChartPoint; series: IChartSeries; category: string | number; }
